items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 17, 2022 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I was working with Phil Ranelin, which we started a partnership, Tribe Records.

ctx.x: No, well anyway she wanted me to meet a young lady that she, in her mind was a real credible lady and she thought that we could get married and make a family together, you know have kids and whatnot. Never did happen. But it happened where she was very instrumental in managing and administrating some of my gigs and my career.
